chunks: Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (peace be upon him) says:
One who is patient and blind and hopeful of divine rewards and is a lover of the progeny of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) there would be no accounting of deeds for him.
ai.seo_question: Who is exempt from the accounting of deeds according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: In Thawab al-Amal, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights this specific combination of traits as a mark of high spiritual station, where physical affliction (blindness) and emotional devotion (love for Ahl al-Bayt) are transformed into merits through patience (sabr). This exemption from detailed accounting (hisab) underscores the Shia emphasis on the intercessory power of love for the Prophet's progeny and the purifying nature of divine grace for the steadfast believer.
